t: A tiny Realtek Wi-Fi and Bluetooth chip that speaks both 2.4 and 5 GHz.
steps: Buy a BW16 dev board from an online marketplace or a bare BW16 module from Seeed Studio.
Add the Realtek Ameba board package, version 3.0.8 or later, and pick the BW16 board.
Turn on the Erase Flash option for the first upload. Turn it off again afterward.
Hold the burn button and tap reset in case the upload does not start on its own.
Upload the Blink example and watch the RGB LED.
Try the Wi-Fi scan example next to see networks on both bands.
Check the Ameba pin table before wiring any sensor.
meta: Open Board. From $5. A few stores.
